content: Dissolve two tablets in 4 ounces of water before consuming them orally. If you are in the United States or Canada and experience side effects, contact your doctor for medical advice. In the event of an overdose, if the individual has severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. For safe disposal, consult your pharmacist or local waste disposal company. This information was last updated in May 2024.
